mentions.name: RewriteCmd
mentions.description: A free macOS menu bar app that rewrites text in place across any application. Select text and hit Cmd-Shift-R to have it rewritten instantly. It is BYOK: it uses the user's own Claude/OpenAI/Mistral API key, so text never touches a third-party server.
mentions.problem: Fixes the friction of copy/pasting text into GPT to correct or improve it.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built a free macOS menu bar app that rewrites text in place across any
application. Select text, hit Cmd-Shift-R, text gets rewritten instantly.

BYOK — uses your own Claude/OpenAI/Mistral API key, so text never touches
a third-party server.
